sources.summary: Japanese practice Yano Aoyama Architecture Design has completed a public toilet for the Tobe Zoological Park in Ehime Prefecture, creating two chiselled concrete blocks that are topped by a thin roof of naturally curved cedar. Located alongside the entrance gates of Tobe Zoo, the two public bathroom cubicles replace outdated toilets with fully accessible facilities The post Yano Aoyama Architecture Design tops public toilet in Japan with sweeping timber canopy appeared first on Dezeen .
